# OpenAI-native Lean Agent Skill Collections V7.2

This archive contains every V7.2 profile, the V7.1-to-V7.2 update pack, Compound Engineering integration decisions, the eight-pass audit, release validation, and SHA-256 inventory.

Install one overlapping primary profile only: Core, Engineering, or Complete. The standalone Communication, Get It Done, and Gauntlet packs duplicate skills found in some larger profiles.

The embedded SHA inventory covers the contained release files but intentionally excludes this outer master ZIP. Use the separately supplied master SHA-256 file for the outer archive.
